excerpt: Learn how LendingTree built a production multi-agent mortgage assistant on Amazon Bedrock. Three coordinated agents use LangGraph, the Model Context Protocol, and Amazon Nova models with built-in guardrails to deliver 24/7 personalized mortgage guidance while meeting strict financial-services compliance.
